data.desc: TELUS Digital is a premier global technology services provider. We help the world's biggest brands win the moments that matter, for their customers and their business. Our teams design and operate the AI-powered experiences customers rely on across web, mobile, conversational AI, and human agents. Across the AI lifecycle, we supply the data that trains frontier models, and we build, run, and protect AI for enterprises and for ourselves, at scale, every day. Guided by our Humanity-in-the-Loop principles, our 80,000+ team members deliver for 600+ clients in over 35 countries.
